import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyChartRestriction

/-!
# Divisor chart quotients on regular sections

The canonical restriction of the unit module agrees with the structure-sheaf
restriction on sections. Consequently the chart quotient kills a regular
section exactly when the ambient normalized quotient does.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

private theorem leftAdjointUniq_hom_app_homEquiv_symm
    {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    {F F' : C ⥤ D} {G : D ⥤ C} (adj1 : F ⊣ G) (adj2 : F' ⊣ G)
    {x : C} {e : D} (g : x ⟶ G.obj e) :
    (adj1.leftAdjointUniq adj2).hom.app x ≫ (adj2.homEquiv x e).symm g =
      (adj1.homEquiv x e).symm g := by
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_counit, Adjunction.homEquiv_counit, ← Category.assoc,
    ← (adj1.leftAdjointUniq adj2).hom.naturality g, Category.assoc]
  exact congrArg (F.map g ≫ ·) (Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq_hom_app_counit adj1 adj2 e)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The unit restriction comparison acts by the structure-sheaf isomorphism. -/
theorem unitRestrictIso_hom_app_apply {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f] (V : Y.Opens) (r : Γ(X, f ''ᵁ V)) :
    (unitRestrictIso f).hom.val.app (op V) r = (f.appIso V).hom r := by
  have hcollapse : (unitRestrictIso f).hom =
      ((restrictAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _).symm
        (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom) := by
    change ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).app
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).hom ≫ (pullbackUnitIso f).hom = _
    rw [show (pullbackUnitIso f).hom =
        SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom from rfl,
      ← SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_symm_unitToPushforwardObjUnit,
      show ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).app
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).hom =
        ((restrictAdjunction f).leftAdjointUniq
          (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)).hom.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) from rfl]
    exact leftAdjointUniq_hom_app_homEquiv_symm (restrictAdjunction f)
      (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f) _
  rw [hcollapse, Adjunction.homEquiv_counit]
  change (((restrictAdjunction f).counit.app
      (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).val.app (op V)).hom
    ((((restrictFunctor f).map
      (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom)).val.app
      (op V)).hom r) = _
  erw [PresheafOfModules.pushforward_map_app_apply,
    SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit_val_app_apply,
    SheafOfModules.pushforwardPushforwardAdj_counit_app_val_app]
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom]
  have hops : (f.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.adjunction).unit.app V =
      eqToHom (f.preimage_image_eq V).symm := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hops, CommRingCat.comp_apply]
  rfl

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- On an open subscheme, the inverse unit comparison leaves regular sections unchanged. -/
@[simp] theorem unitRestrictIso_inv_app_ι_apply {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (U : X.Opens) (V : (U : Scheme).Opens) (r : Γ((U : Scheme), V)) :
    (unitRestrictIso U.ι).inv.val.app (op V) r = r := by
  calc
    (unitRestrictIso U.ι).inv.val.app (op V) r =
        (unitRestrictIso U.ι).hom.val.app (op V)
          ((unitRestrictIso U.ι).inv.val.app (op V) r) := by
      rw [unitRestrictIso_hom_app_apply, Opens.ι_appIso]
      rfl
    _ = r := by
      change (((unitRestrictIso U.ι).inv ≫
        (unitRestrictIso U.ι).hom).val.app (op V)) r = r
      rw [Iso.inv_hom_id]
      rfl

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily

variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T : Over S}

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- A chart quotient evaluates the ambient normalized quotient on the same
regular section, followed by the canonical restriction-to-pullback comparison. -/
theorem chartQuotient_app_apply_eq_normalizedQuotient
    (x : DivFamily π T) (U : (pullback π T.hom).Opens)
    (V : (U : Scheme).Opens) (r : Γ((U : Scheme), V)) :
    (chartQuotient x U).val.app (op V) r =
      ((Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).hom.app x.F).val.app (op V)
        ((normalizedQuotient x).val.app (op (U.ι ''ᵁ V)) r) := by
  rw [chartQuotient_eq_restrict_normalized]
  change ((Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).hom.app x.F).val.app (op V)
    (((Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map (normalizedQuotient x)).val.app (op V)
      ((Modules.unitRestrictIso U.ι).inv.val.app (op V) r)) = _
  rw [Modules.unitRestrictIso_inv_app_ι_apply]
  rfl

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The chart and ambient normalized quotients kill exactly the same regular sections. -/
theorem chartQuotient_eq_zero_iff_normalizedQuotient
    (x : DivFamily π T) (U : (pullback π T.hom).Opens)
    (V : (U : Scheme).Opens) (r : Γ((U : Scheme), V)) :
    (chartQuotient x U).val.app (op V) r = 0 ↔
      (normalizedQuotient x).val.app (op (U.ι ''ᵁ V)) r = 0 := by
  rw [chartQuotient_app_apply_eq_normalizedQuotient]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hh := congrArg
      (fun t => ((Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).inv.app x.F).val.app
        (op V) t) h
    change (((Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).hom.app x.F ≫
      (Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).inv.app x.F).val.app (op V))
        ((normalizedQuotient x).val.app (op (U.ι ''ᵁ V)) r) = _ at hh
    rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_app] at hh
    change (normalizedQuotient x).val.app (op (U.ι ''ᵁ V)) r = _ at hh
    simpa only [map_zero] using hh
  · intro h
    rw [h, map_zero]

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily
